title: Causal Online Residual and Source Performance State Engine
mission: Implement multi-timescale, source/model/regime residual states that update only after settlement.
steps: Implement EWMA half-lives 5/10/20/40 plus robust median and shrinkage.
Maintain signed bias, absolute error, volatility, over/under streaks and support counts.
Key states by source era, model, season and carefully selected regimes with hierarchical fallback.
acceptance: State at T depends only on settled dates before T
failure: Settlement unavailable: freeze state; never infer residual
